93:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You come on strong from the very first meeting, don't you.」

93:t_10:9.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Do I? Sorry to disappoint your hopes, but that's just the kind of guy I am.」

93:t_10:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well then, if you'll excuse me.」

93:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$ニコラ$$. I can't help noticing the fear hiding behind all that brimming confidence and free-spiritedness of yours.」

93:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What you muttered from the bottom of your heart when you shot down the $$宇宙怪獣$$ with the power of $$トップレス$$... It produced a fine $$Ｚチップ$$.」

93:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... 50 Z... I'll add this to the unit's stock.」

93:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, $$ニコラ$$... I have no intention of getting involved in what it is you fear, but I do look forward to you producing more $$Ｚチップ$$.」

93:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Pleased to meet you, $$ノノ$$. I am $$ＡＧ$$, an agent robot of $$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$.」

93:t_10:21.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you for introducing yourself so promptly. This $$ノノ$$... was born on Mars...」

93:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... no need for formal greetings. I may not look it, but I am quite a busy robot myself.」

93:t_10:23.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I heard about AG's work from Miss $$スズネ$$. $$ノノ$$ will help out too.」

93:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Are you sure? I would think the Daily Life team suits you better, $$ノノ$$...」

93:t_10:25.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well, you see... I went and broke the auto-cooker right away...」

93:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you were fired, as they say!? On your first day!?」

93:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see. As a fellow robot, I, $$ＡＧ$$, will hire you, $$ノノ$$.」

93:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. If a cute girl becomes our shop's poster girl, I'm sure we'll get more customers.」

93:t_10:31.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Understood! Unworthy as I am, $$ノノ$$ will do her very best with hard work and guts!」

93:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here we go! Let's give it our all again today...」

94:t_000:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「...We haven't run into any $$サイデリアル$$ this whole way.」

94:t_000:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「Their main force may have moved to $$蒼の地球$$.」

94:t_000:2.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「You mean they lost interest in $$翠の地球$$?」

94:t_000:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「If that $$バルビエル$$'s words are to be believed.」

94:t_000:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「And it's such a beautiful planet...」

94:t_000:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「But according to $$ロラン$$, $$翠の地球$$ had its nature destroyed once in the past.」

94:t_000:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「And it apparently took a long time for the natural environment to recover to what it is now.」

94:t_000:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Lost nature recovering over many long years... I hear the world of the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ was the same.」

94:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But to the $$サイデリアル$$, Earth's only value is probably as the key to drawing out $$次元力$$.」

94:t_000:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Is something the matter, Captain?」

94:t_000:11.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We did liberate $$翠の地球$$ and were able to gather new forces...」

94:t_000:12.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we can't say we've won by any means. We're completely on the back foot against the $$サイデリアル$$.」

94:t_000:13.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The battles ahead will surely remain harsh.」

94:t_000:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We have to strike $$ラース・バビロン$$ and settle this before it's too late...」

94:t_001:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「I've detected a force approaching us...!」

94:t_002:1.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy units show no life signs!」

94:t_002:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are they the ones we fought before?」

94:t_002:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, launch. We will intercept the enemy units.」

94:t_003:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Not another army of unidentified robots!」

94:t_003:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Look, $$正太郎$$! There are robots from $$ギシン星$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ here too!」

94:t_003:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So they really are connected to the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...」

94:t_003:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Save that for later! First we knock down whatever's coming at us!」

94:t_003:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ランド$$'s the same as ever.」

94:t_003:5.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yes. He's someone you can count on.」

94:t_004:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Just call me $$ランド$$. I'll be counting on you, $n.」

94:t_004:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「I thought you'd be dwelling on what $$バルビエル$$ did to you, but you seem all right.」

94:t_004:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you add that man's sweltering smile to $n and divide by two, it would come out just right.」

94:t_004:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'd recommend getting yourself added to that mix too.」

94:t_005:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「We don't know who the enemy is, but since they're coming at us, it looks like we have no choice but to intercept.」

94:t_005:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Wait, Captain! Another force is entering this area!」

94:t_006:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「No matter how many times I hear it, that's a great name.」

94:t_006:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「Are those the people you met on Earth?」

94:t_006:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. They're pretty capable for this world.」

94:t_006:5.en:
$$チコ$$
「So what do we do? Just until the main event shows up, but do we make contact with them and...」

94:t_006:6.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「No, I want to run a test first. ...Is that all right, $$姫$$?」

94:t_006:7.en:
$$ラルク$$
「If that's what $$ニコラ$$ has decided.」

94:t_006:8.en:
$$チコ$$
「(Sheesh... what does she see in a guy like that...)」

94:t_006:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Members of $$トップレス$$, please respond. This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$, captain of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$, of $c.」

94:t_006:10.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「$c... So that's what you're called.」

94:t_006:11.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We are currently engaged with an unidentified force. They will likely attack indiscriminately.」

94:t_006:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I propose we cooperate in dealing with them here.」

94:t_006:13.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you for the warning. But we'll be doing things our own way.」

94:t_006:14.en:
$$クラン$$
「What is with that guy!? We're saying this out of kindness!」

94:t_006:15.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Is there some reason they can't fight alongside us... or are they just that confident...」

94:t_006:16.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well then, let's go, $$姫$$, $$チコ$$. Let's show them our power.」

94:t_006:17.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Um... $$ニコラ$$... $$ノノ$$ is here too, you know...」

94:t_006:18.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$, you're my support. You don't need to go out front.」
